say: Making HAL-FORMS carry the release changed the servers and the generator, so the original HAL Schema Forms script was replayed again, unchanged, at L0, everything in one answer, and at L2, forms and schemas fetched by link and checked by hash. Same five releases, same four promoted, 504 stopped. Its script and pins also come out of the generator identical, line for line.
